messages:
Julie - Customer Success: FYI customer ACME reports quantized endpoint is slower than FP16 after we flipped their int4 rollout. p95 jumped ~180ms -> ~420ms. Region: us-west2, endpoint ep-89, model redwood-llama2-small-4bit. They've paused traffic. Can eng take a quick look?
Sasha - Oncall: On it. Do we have a repro and logs?
Julie - Customer Success: Repro steps: curl /v1/generate with their prompt set (link), sample=200, avg seq_len ~512. Perf dump uploaded: s3://acme-telemetry/quant_dump_195123.log
Omar - Eng Runtime: Looking now. Quick scan: high KV cache miss rate in that dump — lots of cold cache starts from many short-lived hosts. Also kernel selection shows matmul_int4_v2_slow selected for long sequences on A100 gen1. Locally switching to fp16 kernel reduced p95 to ~190ms. I'll run a microprofile.
Li - Eng Platform: Noted. Int4 kernels sometimes regresses on long seqs if the matmul path picks a fallback kernel. Also small batch sizes + long sequences punish quant kernels more. Could be batching heuristics + KV warmup combined.
Omar - Eng Runtime: Profiling snippet from the trace: ```kernel_selected: matmul_int4_v2_slow
type: int4
seq_len: 512
batch: 1
p95: 420ms
---
fp16_kernel: matmul_fp16_opt
seq_len: 512
batch: 1
p95: 185ms```
Sasha - Oncall: Ok plan: a) reproduce with harness b) quick mitigation — route ACME to fp16 variant c) deeper root cause work on kernel selection & batching.
Julie - Customer Success: Customer wants ETA, they're ok with temporary FP16 fallback. Can we do a canary today?
Omar - Eng Runtime: Yes I can push a route override to send ep-89 traffic to fp16 within ~20m. I'll also run a microbenchmark across seq_len buckets to find the kernel breakpoint.
Li - Eng Platform: For a longer-term fix we should tune dynamic batching window (increase to ~25ms) for that endpoint to allow better int4 batching. That will help throughput but may slightly raise median latency. Suggest we do FP16 fallback now while we validate batching change.
Omar - Eng Runtime: Agreed. I'll deploy FP16 canary and start kernel microbench. I'll also add a temporary metric: quant_kernel_p95_by_seq_len so we can detect this class of regressions earlier.
Julie - Customer Success: Thanks — I'll tell ACME: canary to FP16 now, eng investigating kernel/batching root cause, follow-up within 24h. :thumbsup:
MetricsBot: Deploy canary job scheduled for ep-89 at 1951239950 by Omar. Status: started.
Omar - Eng Runtime: Canary live, initial telemetry shows p95 ~190ms now for sampled requests. KV warmup seems to be less impactful when using fp16 kernel.
Sasha - Oncall: Closing immediate alert. Follow-ups: (1) Omar to post microbench results & PR for kernel routing heuristics, (2) Li to run a safe batching window experiment, (3) Julie to share customer comms and confirm rollback criteria.
Julie - Customer Success: Noted. I'll confirm with ACME and keep thread updated.
Omar - Eng Runtime: I'll upload the microbench artifacts to /internal/perf/195123_omar_quant_kernels.tar and link in #eng-runtime when done.
Julie - Customer Success: Appreciate it — will update ACME and reopen if they see any issues.
